Not a residual DoS at defaults. Fix: one doc line that http2.max_headers must stay 100 on agent-facing listeners; reword waiver 'not tested separately'; optional pin of the defaults in http2_opts tests.
classification_rationale: Missing doc/pin, not a contradiction.

summary: gun 2.8.0 enforces 32768 on UPSTREAM response header/trailer lists (the channel sets none): chaos injector (raw h2 stub, real yuzu_grpc_client) saw only the oversize call fail with {error,stream_error} in 10-44 ms; in-flight siblings on the same connection completed ok; no gun_down, no redial; 30 sequential bad calls then a normal call ok. Old stack returned ok. Reachability from the real C++ server unconfirmed (gRPC C++ normally caps metadata far lower). Raised also as up-1, sre-3, er-5, gw-5. trigger: more than 10 over-limit header lists in 10 s on one connection that carries other peers (L7 h2 proxy in front of :50051)
summary: Verified: after 10 header-bloat refusals in 10 s (max_reset_stream_rate) cowboy closes the connection with GOAWAY enhance_your_calm and every in-flight co-tenant stream on that connection dies ({connection_lost}); old stack served all 14 bloated requests (the CVE). Blast radius is the attacker's own connection on the default direct-mTLS topology (E1 raise does NOT apply: the co-tenant case needs a non-default topology). It becomes co-tenant impact only behind an L7 h2 proxy that shares one upstream connection across agents; the gateway documents that shape (origin.sources forwarded_for/trusted_hops, per the origin-trust routed row), so reachability is likely, not speculative. Derivation: I5 MEDIUM, E4+E5 no raise => MEDIUM/SHOULD. This is the intended price of the fix. Fix: document it (sre-1) and tell operators not to share one upstream h2 connection across agents.
classification_rationale: Behaviour change is the intended fix; operator guidance missing (see sre-1).

The header-list paragraph is also appended to an already very long table cell and the 'Connection ceilings and the unauthenticated ports' section has no header-list mention. Raised as sre-1, sre-2, er-2, er-3, doc-3. Fix: add a bullet to 'Connection ceilings and the unauthenticated ports' with those facts and cross-link from the http2 row.
